scope: The stock Launcher3 home surface contains the installed sample application and the sample Activity starts and renders through SurfaceFlinger to native SWS.

markers.activity_start: START u0 {act=android.intent.action.MAIN cat=[android.intent.category.LAUNCHER] flg=0x10000000 cmp=dev.scarlet.compat/.MainActivity} from uid 1000

home: sample application icon in the hotseat

launch_path: The bounded manager requested the sample activity through ActivityManager.startActivityAsUserWithFeature after Launcher3 finished publishing user 0. The same component is listed on the Launcher home surface.
limitations: This verifies programmatic Activity launch rather than a host-generated pointer click.
SystemUI still exits during MediaFlags initialization; Launcher and the sample application remain usable.
